metas.name: Steins;Gate
metas.description: After discovering time travel, a university student and his colleagues must use their knowledge of it to stop an evil organization and their diabolical plans.

metas.name: Haikyu!!
metas.description: Determined to be like the volleyball championship's star player nicknamed "the small giant", Shoyo joins his school's volleyball club.

metas.name: Your Lie in April
metas.description: A piano prodigy who lost his ability to play after suffering a traumatic event in his childhood is forced back into the spotlight by an eccentric girl with a secret of her own.

metas.name: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
metas.description: The proudly privileged top two students of an elite school each makes it their mission to be the first to extract a confession of love from the other.

metas.name: Great Teacher Onizuka
metas.description: About Eikichi Onizuka, a 22-year-old ex-gangster member and a virgin. He has one ambition that no one ever expected from him. His sole life purpose is to become the greatest high school teacher ever.

metas.name: Fruits Basket
metas.description: After Tohru is taken in by the Soma family, she learns that twelve family members transform involuntarily into animals of the Chinese zodiac and helps them deal with the emotional pain caused by the transformations.

metas.name: The Tatami Galaxy
metas.description: When a nameless student at Kyoto University encounters a demigod one night, he asks to relive the past three years in order to win the heart of Ms. Akashi, the object of his affection.

metas.name: Doraemon
metas.description: The misadventures of Doraemon, a robot cat from the future, who with his gadgets, is sent back in time to help make Nobita Nobi, a boy without much talent, a better person.

metas.name: Bocchi the Rock!
metas.description: Hitori "Bocchi-chan" Gotoh is a lonely high school girl whose heart lies in her guitar. One day, she meets Nijika Ijichi and joins 'Kessoku Band'. After that, her daily life starts to change little by little.

metas.name: Clannad
metas.description: A high school student who cares little about school or his future decides to help a lonely girl repeating her final year in re-establishing the school's drama club.

metas.name: Yuri!!! On Ice
metas.description: After suffering defeat, Yuri Katsuki hangs up his ice skates for good. But will an encounter with two top skaters reignite his passion?

metas.name: Welcome to the N.H.K.
metas.description: This surreal dramedy follows Satou Tatsuhiro as he attempts to escape the evil machinations of the NHK.

metas.name: Barakamon
metas.description: A proud young calligrapher is punished for punching a critic by being sent to a faraway island in the east coast of Japan. But as he meets and lives with the island's friendly people, his attitude begins to improve.

metas.name: Bunny Drop
metas.description: A man adopts his six-year-old aunt and raises her as his own kid.

metas.name: March Comes in Like a Lion
metas.description: A 17 year old socially awkward orphaned shogi player, dealing with adult problems like financial difficulties, loneliness, and depression.

links.name: March Comes in Like a Lion

metas.name: Natsume's Book of Friends
metas.description: When Natsume Takashi inherits a book that belonged to his late grandmother he realizes the book is filled with the names of spirits she defeated and bound to her will. He then decides to return their names so they can be free once...

metas.name: Chihayafuru
metas.description: Chihaya meets a boy named Arata, a talented karuta player who thinks that she has a potential to become a great player. Chihaya then takes on a new dream of becoming Japan's best karuta player.

metas.name: Food Wars: Shokugeki no Soma
metas.description: Soma Yukihira enrolls in an elite culinary school to become a full-time chef and surpass his father's culinary skills.

metas.name: Horimiya
metas.description: Two very different people - an academically successful schoolgirl and a quiet loser schoolboy - meet and develop a friendship.

metas.name: Bakuman.
metas.description: Mahiro and Takagi team up to pursue their dreams of making it in the manga industry while sharing experiences, successes and failures along the way.

metas.name: The Dangers in My Heart
metas.description: Fascinated by the macabre, Kyotaro fantasizes about acting on his twisted thoughts to the detriment of his classmates. His heart was dark until an encounter with Anna lit a spark within it in a classic tale of boy meets girl.

metas.name: Sound! Euphonium
metas.description: Kumiko, a girl with absolutely no ambition, decides to change herself now that she has started her high school life and try to leave her hobby, playing euphonium in orchestra aside but she totally cannot forget it anyway.

metas.name: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU
metas.description: About an antisocial high school student named Hikigaya Hachiman with a distorted view on life and no friends or girlfriend. His life change when he was forced to enter the "Volunteer Service Club" by his teacher.

metas.name: Shirobako
metas.description: A group of friends move to Tokyo and get jobs in the anime industry.

metas.name: K-On!
metas.description: K-ON is about 5 high school girls who become friends through the Light Music Club. Yui the lead guitarist, Tsumugi the keyboardist, Mio the bassist, Azusa the rhythm guitarist, and Ritsu the drummer. K-ON is the story of 5 aspirin...

metas.name: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You
metas.description: Sawako wishes to make friends but her weird vibe and lack of communication skills are getting in her way. Fortunately, it's no longer the case since she met Kazehaya, an extroverted guy who she couldn't help but to fall in love with.

links.name: Kimi ni Todoke: From Me to You

metas.name: ReLIFE
metas.description: A young man, failing at life, is offered a new start as a 10 years younger high-school student.

metas.name: Hyouka
metas.description: Hyouka centers on Oreki Hotarou and his life in the Classic Literature Club. His mundane world is flipped upside down as they begin to solve various mysteries.

metas.name: The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya
metas.description: The crazy adventures of the SOS Brigade, led by the insane but charismatic Haruhi.

metas.name: Daily Lives of High School Boys
metas.description: Join Tadakuni, Hidenori and Yoshitake as they undergo the trials and tribulations of life in high school!.

links.name: Daily Lives of High School Boys

metas.name: Girls Band Cry
metas.description: Nina Iseri leaves high school, aims for Tokyo university. One girl betrayed by friends, another abandoned by parents, both struggle with part-time jobs. Yet, they all long for a place to belong and find solace through singing.

metas.name: Komi Can't Communicate
metas.description: An elite and aloof schoolgirl is in fact severely withdrawn and anxious about communicating with others. An ordinary schoolboy befriends her and helps her to open up and talk with people.

metas.name: The Pet Girl of Sakurasou
metas.description: Sorata is a normal student living in an abnormal dorm and he wants desperately to escape. But his plans are put on hold when a new student moves in. Attentions stray and sanity frays as the housebreaking continues in Pet Girl of S...

metas.name: Nisemonogatari
metas.description: Set after the events of Bakemonogatari, one of the men who deceived Hitagi, Kaiki Deishu, returns to town to spread the incantation which cursed Nadeko before. Koyomi's sisters Karen and Tsukihi try to stop him.

metas.name: Welcome to Demon-School, Iruma-kun
metas.description: When Iruma's parents sell him to a powerful demon, the kindhearted 14-year-old doesn't expect to be adopted and sent to a demon high school.

metas.name: Charlotte
metas.description: The story takes place in an alternate reality where a small percentage of children manifest superhuman abilities upon reaching puberty. A focus is placed on Yuu Otosaka, a high school boy who awakens the ability to temporarily pos...

metas.name: Golden Time
metas.description: With freshmen law students Banri and Mitsuo, it's friendship at first sight. But trouble gets stirred up with talk of a fiancé.

metas.name: Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions
metas.description: Yuuta suffered from "chuunibyou" while he was in middle school. When he graduated, he try to forgot about it but he accidentally got into a contract with Rikka and disrupts his desperately ordinary life.

metas.name: Kokoro Connect
metas.description: Five school friends experience strange supernatural phenomena that put their relationships to test.

metas.name: Nekomonogatari (Kuro)
metas.description: A kind of prequel to the final 'Bakemonogatari' arc, that revolves around the oddity that possesses Araragi's class rep Hanekawa Tsubasa.

metas.name: Free!
metas.description: Four high school students: Haruka, Makoto, Nagisa and Rin, all took part in a swimming tournament shortly before the end of high school and then lost touch with each other. Years later, they reunite.

metas.name: Tsuredure Children
metas.description: A series depicting various scenarios of young love. These stories range from a boy, crippled by his absolute lack of confidence in himself, cannot even accept the fact that the girl of his dreams actually asked him out on a date, to the near-psychotic girl that pours her own blood into her homemade chocolate in order to win his heart.

metas.name: WATAMOTE: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!
metas.description: Socially awkward Tomoko dreams of becoming a popular high school girl, but her goal may be further away than she thinks.

links.name: WATAMOTE: No Matter How I Look at It, It's You Guys' Fault I'm Not Popular!

metas.name: Seitokai yakuindomo
metas.description: Takatoshi Tsuda joins Ousai Academy, a co-ed high school that until recently had been an all-girl school, where he is asked to join the student council as vice-president and a male representative.

metas.name: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
metas.description: The loves and lives of a group of school children.

links.name: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle

metas.name: Haganai: I Don't Have Many Friends
metas.description: A friendless teenager, feared by his fellow classmates, joins a club hoping to finally make some friends.

links.name: Haganai: I Don't Have Many Friends

metas.name: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend
metas.description: Aki, a highschool otaku work to support his game making. With remarkable luck, he bumps into Kato, the most beautiful girl he has ever seen. Naturally, the meeting twists his life into a complicated relationships.

links.name: Saekano: How to Raise a Boring Girlfriend

metas.name: Sankarea
metas.description: A zombie-obsessed boy attempts to resurrect his dead cat using an ancient text. He meets Rea, a troubled girl seeking rebirth, whose path intertwines with his supernatural pursuits.

metas.name: True Beauty
metas.description: Once bullied for her looks, Jugyeong transforms herself using the art of makeup. When she joins a new school with a True Beauty goddess competition, offering winners the chance of recruitment by entertainment agencies, she instantly becomes a top candidate! But her new identity is at stake when heartthrob Suho Lee accidentally sees her bare face. Will her elite status be short-lived?

metas.name: Code Geass
metas.description: After being given a mysterious power to control others, an outcast prince becomes the masked leader of the rebellion against an all-powerful empire.

metas.name: Kingdom
metas.description: In ancient China, a young boy dreams of becoming the greatest general of the Qin Kingdom.

metas.name: Masamune-kun's Revenge
metas.description: Rejected by the gorgeous Adagaki Aki for his weight, Makabe Masamune slims down, adopts a new persona, and reemerges as an attractive teenager. His goal is to make Aki fall for him, then reject her as harshly as she did him.

metas.name: Haibara's Teenage New Game+
metas.description: Natsuki Haibara thought his high school years were a complete failure—until he suddenly wakes up as a freshman again, armed with all he learned in college. Determined to rewrite his school days, he joins the popular crowd, makes friends he never had, and grows closer to his crush. But second chances aren’t as easy as hitting “Restart.” Can Natsuki turn his regrets into a rainbow-colored youth?!

metas.name: Watari-kun's ****** Is About to Collapse
metas.description: Naoto Watari lives solely for his little sister, Suzushiro, until his chaotic childhood friend, Satsuki, storms back into his life. Without uttering a single word, her very presence ignites buried memories and unravels his rigid routine. As tensions rise and secrets surface, Naoto’s devotion to Suzushiro clashes with unresolved pain, threatening to collapse his fragile world.

metas.name: Ore no imouto ga konna ni kawaii wake ga nai
metas.description: Normal 17-year-old Kyosuke isn't close with his 14-year-old sister Kirino. But then her secret otaku hobby gives them a chance to reconnect.

links.name: Ore no imouto ga konna ni kawaii wake ga nai

metas.description: The Republic of San Magnolia has been attacked by its neighbor, the Empire.

metas.name: Monster
metas.description: Tenma, a brilliant neurosurgeon with a promising future, risks his career to save the life of a critically wounded young boy. The boy, now a charismatic young man, reappears 9 years later in the midst of a string of unusual serial...

metas.name: Link Click
metas.description: Using superpowers to enter their clientele's photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at "Time Photo Studio," a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis.

metas.name: Erased
metas.description: 29-year-old Satoru Fujinuma is sent back in time 18 years to prevent the events leading to his mother's death, which began with a series of kidnappings while he was in 5th grade.

metas.name: Elfen Lied
metas.description: Two teenagers take in a mutant girl who has lost her memories.

metas.name: Tokyo Ghoul
metas.description: A Tokyo college student is attacked by a ghoul, a superpowered human who feeds on human flesh. He survives, but has become part ghoul and becomes a fugitive on the run.

metas.name: Fire Force
metas.description: A superhuman firefighter force is formed to deal with supernatural fire incidents.

metas.name: Eromanga Sensei
metas.description: A young writer who works with an anonymous artist discovers that the artist is his little sister.

metas.name: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day
metas.description: Five childhood companions reunite when the ghost of their dead friends appears, and demands they grant her final wish.

links.name: Anohana: The Flower We Saw That Day

metas.name: Darling in the Franxx
metas.description: In a future world where humanity has been driven to endangerment by giant beasts, a strike force is assembled to destroy the monsters and save the world.

metas.name: Terror in Resonance
metas.description: Tokyo has been decimated by a terrorist attack, the only clue to the culprit's identity is a bizarre internet video. Two mysterious children form Sphinx, a clandestine entity determined to pull the trigger on this world.

metas.name: Gangsta.
metas.description: Two handymen take on jobs for both the mob and the police that no one else can handle. Worick and Nicolas work in a town which is full of mafia, hoodlums and prostitutes. They face a challenge after taking on a job of crushing a gang

metas.name: Highschool of the Dead
metas.description: High school students are overwhelmed with the start of the zombie apocalypse.

metas.name: Btooom!
metas.description: A young man gets transported into a video game he plays called Btooom. A plot is uncovered involving an organization that aims to conquer the world by dominating the virtual world.

metas.name: 91 Days
metas.description: The story takes place in Lawless, a town thriving on black market sales of illicitly brewed liquor. Avilio returns to Lawless after some time away, following the murder of his family in a mafia dispute there.

metas.name: Spice and Wolf
metas.description: Kraft Lawrence goes from town to town to make profits as a travelling merchant, with the help of a wolf deity by the name of Holo.

metas.name: Deadman Wonderland
metas.description: After being falsely convicted for the murder of his entire class, a young man must learn to survive in a mysterious prison with a perverted take on incarceration while also looking to clear his name.

metas.name: The Irregular at Magic High School
metas.description: Siblings Tatsuya and Miyuki are pitted against each other when they enroll at Magic High School.

links.name: The Irregular at Magic High School

metas.name: K
metas.description: A young boy is wanted for a crime he has no recollection of committing and must go on the run, hunted by two kings and their forces.

metas.name: Journal with Witch
metas.description: Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family.

metas.name: Grimgar, Ashes and Illusions
metas.description: Haruhiro suddenly wakes up, with no memory but his name. There are a lot of people around, but noone seems to know anything. Haruhiro forms a party of some of the people and start exploring.

metas.name: MIGNON
metas.description: In a brutal underground world, a vampire medic and a wounded young fighter form a fragile bond—one built on pain, longing, and forbidden desire.

metas.name: A Sign of Affection
metas.description: Yuki Itose is just a typical student dealing with the pressures of college. She is struggling one day on the train when an upperclassman named Itsuomi Nagi helps her out. As he gradually opens a new world to her, Yuki develops feelings for Itsuomi. A pure love story begins to grow.

metas.name: Fighting Spirit
metas.description: Ippo, a teenage boy with a pure heart and unrelenting determination, discovers a passion for boxing after veteran fighter Takamura saves him from bullies.

metas.name: Gintama
metas.description: In an era where aliens have invaded and taken over feudal Tokyo, an unemployed samurai finds work however he can.

metas.name: The Boondocks
metas.description: Brothers Huey and Riley Freeman experience a culture clash when they leave Chicago to move in with their grandfather in the suburbs.

metas.name: Steins;Gate 0
metas.description: Mad scientist Okabe struggles to recover from past failure and tests a new artificial intelligence

metas.name: Chainsaw Man
metas.description: Following a betrayal, a young man left for dead is reborn as a powerful devil-human hybrid after merging with his pet devil and is soon enlisted into an organization dedicated to hunting devils.

metas.name: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
metas.description: Yoi Takiguchi is a first-year high school student, admired for her handsome looks and honest heart, which earned her the nickname “Prince.” One day, she bumps into Kohaku Ichimura, an upperclassman and another “Prince.” As the two grow closer, is what blossoms between them friendship or love? A youthful love story about a boy and a girl who are both called “Princes” begins.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A spy on an undercover mission gets married and adopts a child as part of his cover. His wife and daughter have secrets of their own, and all three must strive to keep together.

metas.name: FLCL
metas.description: Mysterious things start happening when 12-year-old Naota meets a strange woman on a Vespa wielding a big guitar.

metas.name: Bakemonogatari
metas.description: Third-year high school student Koyomi Araragi is human again. Cured of his vampirism, he seeks to help other supernaturals with their problems. Koyomi becomes involved in their lives, revealing secrets in people he once knew.

metas.name: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
metas.description: Hinako lives alone by the sea, quietly drifting through life after losing her family years ago. One day, a mermaid named Shiori saves her from a monster and says she’s come to eat her—just not yet. Until then, Shiori will stay by her side and keep her safe. In that moment, a deep hope swells in Hinako: Maybe this girl can finally grant her the ending she’s been waiting for.

metas.name: Blue Orchestra
metas.description: In the fall of his third and final year of middle school, Hajime Aono, a violin prodigy, stopped playing violin for his own personal reasons. But it was also that year when he got to know a girl who told him about a high school with a prestigious school orchestra. Suddenly, the gears in the clock of Aono's life began to turn again. This is the story of a youth drama that brings forth the harmony between music and the heart!

metas.name: Assassination Classroom
metas.description: A powerful creature claims that within a year, Earth will be destroyed by him, but he offers mankind a chance by becoming a homeroom teacher where he teaches his students about how to kill him. An assassination classroom begins.

metas.name: Monogatari Series: Second Season
metas.description: One day, Tsubasa Hanekawa encounters a giant white tiger apparition at an intersection that talks to her. Her house burns down the next day, leaving her homeless.

metas.name: Death Parade
metas.description: After death, humans go to either heaven or hell. But for some, at the instant of their death, they arrive at the Quindecim, a bar attended by the mysterious white-haired Decim.

metas.name: KILL la KILL
metas.description: A young girl arrives at a school of superhumans to find out the truth behind her father's murder.

metas.name: Bungo Stray Dogs
metas.description: Follows Atsushi Nakajima as he joins the Armed Detective Agency in battling the Port Mafia and other superhuman threats to public safety.

metas.name: Odd Taxi
metas.description: In a city which should be familiar, there is the feeling of something a little different.

metas.name: Akame ga Kill!
metas.description: A countryside boy named Tatsumi sets out on a journey to The Capital to make a name for himself and met a seemingly dangerous group of Assassins known as Night Raid. Their journey begins.

metas.name: Frozen Mahjong Tiles: Underground Mahjong Battle Record
metas.description: Not a lot of people know that one of the most talented and ruthless Mahjong players in the city is a young high school boy. Kei is a teenager of few words, but his observation skills, unwavering will and experience in the game allows him to survive in a world full of powerful, rich and dangerous characters. Kei is currently hiding a girl named Amina who has entered the country illegally and protecting her from being deported. He spends his days sleeping through class and his nights playing high stakes Mahjong, waiting for when a worthy opponent arrives.

metas.name: Black Butler
metas.description: Ciel Phantomhive takes care of the many unsettling events in Victorian England. Aided by Sebastian Michaelis, his loyal butler with seemingly inhuman abilities. But is there more to this black-clad butler than meets the eye?

metas.name: Reborn!
metas.description: The baby hitman Reborn, one of the cursed 'Arcabaleno' arrives to teach Tsunayoshi 'No Good Tsuna' Sawada how to become head of the Vongola, a power crime family.

metas.name: Takopi's Original Sin
metas.description: Takopi travels from his home of Happy Planet to spread happiness on Earth, but meets the unsmiling Shizuka. Her school friends and home life are causing her somber expression and pure hearted Takopi is determined to change things.

metas.name: High School DxD
metas.description: After being killed on his first date, idiotic and perverted Issei Hyodo is resurrected as a demon by Rias Gremory only to be recruited into her club of high-class devils.

metas.name: The Future Diary
metas.description: A young man competes with people around the world for a chance to become the succesor of God, with a diary that is able to tell the future.

metas.name: The Devil Is a Part-Timer!
metas.description: Hilarity and fun ensues when Satan ends up in modern day Japan without any magic to return, and starts working part time in a fast food joint.

metas.name: Eden of the East
metas.description: Following a mysterious missile attack in Japan, Saki, a student, meets an amnesiac man, Akira, in Washington DC. Despite his lack of memory, Akira possesses a gun and a phone loaded with a massive digital cash amount.

metas.name: A Certain Scientific Railgun
metas.description: In Toaru Kagaku no Railgun T Mikoto Misaka and her friends prepare for the Daihasei Festival, a seven-day sports competition between different Esper schools, which, of course, also include the Tokiwadai middle school.

metas.name: A Place Further Than the Universe
metas.description: A group of high school girls join an expedition headed towards the Antarctic.

links.name: A Place Further Than the Universe

metas.name: Laid-Back Camp
metas.description: Nadeshiko, a high school student who has moved from Shizuoka to Yamanashi, decides to see the famous Mount Fuji.

metas.name: Eren the Southpaw
metas.description: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.

metas.name: SK8 the Infinity
metas.description: High school sophomore and hardcore skater Reki introduces transfer student Langa to a secret, no-holds-barred race down an abandoned mine.

metas.name: Durarara!!
metas.description: Tired of his mundane life, Mikado Ryugamine decides to move to Ikebukuro, a district in Tokyo, when a friend invites him. Ikebukuro is full of connected mysteries where people's pasts intertwine with the present.

metas.name: Beyond the Boundary
metas.description: High school student Mirai finds that her schoolmate Akihito is an immortal being and half a spirit. When Akihito learns that Mirai is a spirit world warrior their lives become intertwined.

metas.name: Grand Blue Dreaming
metas.description: A college student spends his year at the seaside town of Izu, having fun on the beach with his school friends.

metas.name: Mushi-Shi
metas.description: Mushi Master Ginko travels from place to place investigating occurrences that could be tied to supernatural creatures called Mushi.

metas.name: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!
metas.description: It was a happy day for Kazuma - right up to the moment he died. A goddess intervenes and offers him a second chance in a magical land.

links.name: Konosuba: God's Blessing on This Wonderful World!

metas.name: Little Witch Academia
metas.description: Akko enrolls at the Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy. She's not the best student, but her bright attitude is the key to her and her friends' success.

metas.name: Ascendance of a Bookworm
metas.description: Urano, a young Japanese soon-to-be librarian, dies in an earthquake. She is reincarnated in another world as a young girl named Mayne, but learns books are scarce and only provided to prestigious elites.

metas.name: Violet Evergarden
metas.description: In the aftermath of a great war, Violet Evergarden, a young female ex-soldier, gets a job at a writers' agency and goes on assignments to create letters that can connect people.

metas.name: Serial Experiments Lain
metas.description: Strange things start happening when a withdrawn girl named Lain becomes obsessed with an interconnected virtual realm known as "The Wired".

metas.name: Date a Live
metas.description: Shido meets Tohka, a spirit who destroyed the Earth 30 years ago. To prevent another catastrophe, he must romance her to seal her unstable powers.

metas.name: Blood Lad
metas.description: A vampire punk falls in love with a kind human girl, and when she is killed and turned into a ghost, he sets out on a quest to resurrect her.

metas.name: Is this a Zombie?
metas.description: Ayumu has no pulse and very little luck. Instead of dying (again), Ayumu became the world's first magical girl zombie.

metas.name: Problem Children Are Coming from Another World, Aren't They?
metas.description: A trio of recruits from Earth are enlisted to participate in the Gift Games that decide a group's wealth and reputation.

links.name: Problem Children Are Coming from Another World, Aren't They?

metas.name: No Game, No Life
metas.description: Siblings Sora and Shiro make up the most feared team of pro gamers in the world, The Blank. When they manage to beat God himself in a game of chess, they are sent to a world where all disputes are settled with games.

metas.name: Oshi No Ko
metas.description: A doctor and his recently-deceased patient are reborn as twins to a famous Japanese musical idol and navigate the highs and lows of the Japanese entertainment industry as they grow up together through their lives.

metas.name: Summer Time Rendering
metas.description: Due to the death of his childhood friend, Shinpei returns to his native home, but beneath the surface this island seems to hold some secrets.

metas.name: A Certain Magical Index
metas.description: Index flees from powerful organizations that seek to extract its knowledge, sparking conflicts. Helped by Touma, Misaka and friends from the Academy, she struggles to survive.

metas.name: Strike the Blood
metas.description: A powerful vampire causes chaos in Japan. Yukina, an apprentice Sword Shaman, encounters Akatsuki Kojou, the Fourth Primeval.

metas.name: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
metas.description: It’s the year 2020, and Mizuho is having the worst 17th birthday ever. Her parents forgot it’s her birthday, she still can’t seem to get close to the senior she likes, and all her school trips and tournaments are canceled thanks to a new disease going around. She’s convinced she’ll never have the kind of youth she’s always dreamt of…until her childhood friend, Kizuki, suddenly asks her out.

metas.name: Gosick
metas.description: A brilliant Japanese student teams up with an enigmatic young female prodigy to unravel mysteries across 1920s Europe, with their sleuthing adventures leading them through a web of intrigue and suspense.

metas.name: Classroom of the Elite
metas.description: When Kiyotaka enters government-sponsored elite high school, he finds out just how merit-based this education system is.

metas.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai
metas.description: After experiencing "puberty syndrome" himself, high school pariah Sakuta keeps meeting girls suffering from it, including his sister and actor Mai.

links.name: Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai

metas.name: Shiki
metas.description: When many deaths occur in the quiet village of Sotoba, Doctor Toshio Ozaki initially suspects an epidemic but soon becomes convinced that something else is causing them.

metas.name: Orange
metas.description: High school student Naho Takamiya receives a letter from her future self that warns her to avoid mistakes she will make involving a new transfer student, Kakeru Naruse, a troubled boy whom she meets and begins to fall in love with.

metas.name: Infinite Stratos
metas.description: Ichika Orimura is the first male IS pilot, and is forced to attend an all-girls' school where he runs into rivals, childhood friends and corporate spies.

metas.name: Harmony of Mille-Feuille
metas.description: The a cappella club is filled with unique individuals some might say they're a bit odd. Even if they're not flashy or popular, there's a special kind of youth that connects through their voices, creating something truly unique.

metas.name: To LOVE-Ru
metas.description: When an alien from the planet Deviluke runs away and goes into hiding on earth,she meets a human named Yuuki Rito. Watch as she wants to get married to him while he wants no part of it

metas.name: Plastic Memories
metas.description: 18-year-old Tsukasa joins SAI corporation's terminal service department after failing college exams. His job is to recover Giftia androids nearing expiration, working alongside Isla, a Giftia previously relegated to serving tea.

metas.name: The Ancient Magus' Bride
metas.description: Hatori Chise, 15 years old. Lost, without hope and without family - she sells herself to a non-human mage known as Elias Ainsworth. Hesitant, she starts a new life with him as his new apprentice.

metas.name: Snow White with the Red Hair
metas.description: Although her name means 'white as snow', Shirayuki is a cheerful red-haired girl who lives in the town of Tanbarun and works diligently as an apothecary in her herbal shop.

links.name: Snow White with the Red Hair

metas.name: Another
metas.description: When Sasakibara Kouichi transfers to a new school, he can sense something frightening in the atmosphere of his new class, a secret none of them will talk about. At the center is the beautiful girl Misaki Mei.

metas.name: The Drops of God
metas.description: When world-renowned wine critic Toyotaka Kanzaki passes away, he leaves behind an enviable collection. The will promises his estate to whoever correctly guesses the brand and year of the 12 greatest wines he selected, and the legendary wine that stands atop them all, "Drops of God." The challengers are Toyotaka's son, Shizuku Kanzaki, and a young critic, Issei Tomine, who was adopted by Toyotaka.

metas.name: Say "I love you"
metas.description: Tachibana Mei has had no boyfriend and couldn't even make friends. One day she injures Kurosawa Yamato, the most popular boy in school, and for some reason Yamato takes interest in her.

metas.name: A Lull in the Sea
metas.description: Four students from the sea must attend middle school on the land due to the closure of their school.

metas.name: The Fruit of Grisaia
metas.description: Mihama Academy is a prison-like school. It is home to five female students who each have their own reasons. One day, Yuuji the institute's first male student arrives and throws the orderly rhythm of Mihama off balance.

metas.name: Shrouding the Heavens
metas.description: The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

metas.name: Scum's Wish
metas.description: A perfect couple struggles with a secret longing each has for someone else.

metas.name: Katanagatari
metas.description:
The legendary swordsmith Kiki Shikizaki created 1,000 swords in his career. The more of the swords a country owns, the higher its chances are at winning a war. When the shogun emerged victorious, he collected 988 swords, but these were merely the “practice pieces”. The last twelve swords were the crowning achievements of Kiki’s career. Each one of them is so powerful that a single man could defeat an army with it.

Togame, the shogun’s strategist, gets the order to collect these swords. At first she hired a ninja, but each of the swords’ value is so high that the entire ninja clan went rogue once they got hold of one. She then put her trust in another warrior, but he kept the sword for himself. Her final hope now is Shichika, the seventh and last student of the Kyotoryuu School.

metas.name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
metas.description: Two brothers search for a Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their deceased mother goes awry and leaves them in damaged physical forms.

metas.name: Kureyon Shin-chan
metas.description: English language adult parody based on the Japanese series Shinchan (1992). This entry is for the Funimation English dub which originally aired on CN's Adult Swim between 2006 and 2011.

metas.name: Chibi Maruko-chan
metas.description: Meet Maruko, a sweet schoolgirl with a hefty dose of curiosity (and occasional laziness!). She sails through life in a cozy town alongside her loving parents, grandparents, and sister. Maruko has a band of loyal friends, including her closest pal, Tama-chan, but her playful and doting grandpa is at the heart of it all. Life is never dull in this charming series.
